commitments.detail: Each activity will be scheduled within the available two-hour blocks during the power-control period.
Each activity will be scheduled within its allocated block to ensure the main generator supports the required loads without overloading.
The generator load test will be conducted during this block.
The clinic refrigeration transfer will be conducted during this block.
The communications-battery recharge will be conducted during this block.
The water-point pumping will be conducted during this block.
